en.name: Rotating Logo Reveal
en.title: Rotating Logo Reveal: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A cube spins on a long ease-out and stops at the isometric angle where its silhouette forms the logo. Make this logo reveal with Claude Code or Codex.
howto: Cut a cube into three stacked slabs with a gap of 0.05 of the edge and spin it around a tilted axis (0.62, 0.74, 0.26). The spin runs 2.5s (0.2–2.7s) for 1.62 turns, about 1.5 of them in the first second, on expo.out cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) normalized to end exactly at 1, with no overshoot.

The end pose is isometric (rotX 35.264°, rotY −45°) with a vertex toward the camera, so the silhouette is a hexagon that matches the logo. A fixed orthographic camera grows it from 30% to 40% of frame height on the spin curve, and the three faces use three flat gray tones. At 5.0s a second shot flies three slabs in over 0.8s each, staggered 0.08s, and the lockup lands at 6.55–7.45s.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the slabs and the camera. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.
faq: A logo reveal is a short animation that builds up to a brand mark and holds it on screen. Common techniques include spinning, assembling pieces and drawing outlines. This recipe uses a rotation that decelerates onto the logo angle.
How long should a logo reveal be?
In this film the spin takes 2.5s and the stop is held for 2.3s, and the second shot lands the lockup in 0.9s. The last 0.8s of the rotation is a slow approach, which gives the stop a visible landing.

zh.name: 旋转 Logo 揭示动画
zh.title: 旋转 Logo 揭示动画：示例与代码配方
zh.description: 立方体用长缓出旋转，停在轮廓正好是 logo 的等轴角度。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个旋转 Logo 揭示动画。
howto: 把立方体切成三层叠放的板块，间隙为边长的 0.05，绕倾斜轴（0.62, 0.74, 0.26）旋转。旋转在 0.2–2.7s 用 2.5s 转 1.62 圈，第一秒转掉约 1.5 圈，缓动 expo.out（cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)），归一化到正好在 1 结束，无过冲。
终点姿态是等轴视角（rotX 35.264°，rotY −45°），一个顶点朝向相机，轮廓是与 logo 吻合的六边形。固定的正交相机让轮廓高度沿旋转曲线从画面高度的 30% 增长到 40%，三个面用三种平涂灰色。5.0s 切到第二个镜头，三块板各用 0.8s 飞入，错开 0.08s，6.55–7.45s 定格成 lockup。
点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会搭好板块和相机。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。
faq: 什么是 logo 揭示动画？
logo 揭示动画是一段短动画，逐步构成品牌标志并定格在画面上。常见做法有旋转、碎片拼合、描边绘制。这份配方用逐渐减速的旋转停在 logo 的角度上。
这支片子里旋转用 2.5s，停下后保持 2.3s，第二个镜头里 lockup 在 0.9s 内落定。旋转的最后 0.8s 是缓慢逼近，让停下的一刻有明确的落点。
